name: Heavy Stars
rule: Motion laws cost 30% less; gravity can't be set lower. On the sheet: Half gravity’s gravity line is held off, while its notes still sound

name: The Long Night
rule: Vision is 30% shorter everywhere. On the sheet: the guards’ sight range × 0.7, the only sight the simulation has

name: Wildgrowth
rule: Life laws are 25% stronger. On the sheet, line by line: a time comes a quarter sooner, a rate or share is a quarter larger, a multiplier moves a quarter further from 1, and an on/off rule is unchanged; it applies before a harmony does

name: Echoing Skies
rule: Everyone returns once at 40% after being knocked out (the Revival row, 7.3; 12.20). It is one Revival source, and 7.3’s highest N decides

name: Static Storm
rule: Energy wards are 50% stronger. On the sheet: the Static Coil’s shock, what its upgrade scales, × 1.5

name: Quiet Week
rule: Heists are 30 seconds longer, after 5.4’s cap: up to 270 seconds and 8,100 ticks (24.10)
